ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: expand NSW accordions: remove hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content, set aria-expanded=true
ledger.why: collapsed panels are absent from innerText — same class as N-D2 hidden slides; the reskin renders every panel body (Figma Accordion expanded variant 12362:10348)

ledger.what: remove Material Icons ligature spans (.material-icons: keyboard_arrow_down, east, north)
ledger.why: aria-hidden decorative glyphs whose ligature names leak into innerText; donor supplies its own chevron/arrow glyphs via CSS (mapping-brief § Icon-ligature text, "normalize it away")

visibleTextNormalized: Canteen All canteens in NSW public schools must meet certain requirements. These include providing more healthy food and drink options – to make the healthy choice an easy choice for students. Visit Healthy school canteens to learn more. Bon Appetit Catering operate the Fort Street High School canteen and is a family-operated business with over 20 years of experience. They are dedicated to providing high-quality, healthy food options to students and staff. Our canteen is open daily from 8:00am, offering a delicious breakfast menu. Payment can be made via either cash or card or via Flexischools. Our school uses Flexischools for online ordering. Flexischools, operates in more than 1650 schools across Australia, enabling cashless ordering for schools. How to setup your Flexischools account Simply use the QR code to download the Flexischools App from the Apple or Google stores and follow the prompts to create an account. You can also signup through the Flexischools website flexischools.com.au (opens in new window) If you already have a Flexischools account you can simply add a new student to your existing account. Cancelling your order Orders can be cancelled through the Flexischools app prior to being sent to the canteen each morning. To cancel your order click on “Orders” in the Flexischools app and then click on the order you wish to cancel. If the order is still available to cancel, simply click on the cancel button. The full amount of your order will be refunded to your Flexischools Wallet. Fee & Charges A 29c transaction fee is charged on every canteen order placed through the Flexischools App. This fee is in addition to the cost of the canteen items and is charged at the time of purchase. There is an additional surcharge for purchases or account top ups made by credit card or PayPal, however parents can top up their Flexischools wallet by EFT which incurs no surcharge. Please visit Flexischools Help & Support (opens in new window) section for additional information and tips. Our Terms & Conditions can be found here: Legal & Privacy (opens in new window) Contact the Canteen The canteen can be reached on 8585 1628 Parent portal Use our parent portal apps to make a payment, view reports and record absences. Bell times Learn about our start and finish times, breaks and activities.
